fact: Morocco's delegate minister told parliament that the government will subsidise satellite internet (Starlink/VSAT) at 2,500 dirhams per subscription for 4,000 beneficiaries in areas hard to reach by land, within the PNHD whose first phase connected more than 10,640 rural areas in 2018-2024 and whose second phase targets 1,800 more.
title: Morocco Partners with Elon Musk's Starlink to Expand Rural Internet Access
